title: Device Destruction
paragraphs: “If the hole were just a little bigger, I could have had Naofumi hold it open. But it’s too small. There are a few ways to break through this, but I’ll need to pour a lot of magic into it.”
As soon as the rival’s focus wavered, the hole swiftly closed.
“Ah, seriously. It closed again! So nasty! The person who made this has a terrible personality!”
It seems that if the rival loses focus, the hole closes immediately.
“If I could just see the target, my accuracy skill could handle this…”
Itsuki’s skill doesn’t guarantee a hit. It’s not strong enough to hit something that can’t be seen.
“Um…”
At that moment, the big sister’s friend raised her hand.
“What’s wrong, Rifana?”
“If it’s just a small hole, I can slip through and destroy the device.”
“Huh? Hmm… would that be okay?”
Certainly, sending a friend alone in this situation is worrisome. Father glanced at the big sister.
“Rifana is strong enough, I say.”
She’s definitely strong enough not to lose easily, but that’s not what’s worrying Father.
“We’ll help too!”
Not wanting to be left out, Sakura and the others volunteered as well.
Hmm… if Sakura and the others are going along…
“Alright, I’ll do my best with Rifana!”
“I suppose I have no choice. I don’t like taking the form of a chick, but I’ll do it for everyone.”
“If the sun tries to burn Kuro, Kuro will move forward—defying the sun.”
Yuki and the other Filolials were also ready to go. Under that murderous sunlight, everyone’s hearts were united.
“Ugh! Fine then. Even if Gaelion shrinks down, this hole is still too small. I’m not happy about it, but I’ll let them handle it.”
The rival focused her energy. Father cast Aura to enhance the power of the rival’s magic.
“Do your best, Gaelion. Fast Aura X!”

It seems he finally managed to master Fast Aura and cast it at level X. Liberation and the advanced Zweite and Dritte applications haven’t been learned yet. Still, he’s very close to understanding them. He’s already learned up to Dritte through magic books for most other types of magic.
“In situations like this… Dritte Magic Boost X!”
“This should work! Hnnn…”
The rival began gathering power to open the hole. Meanwhile, Father kept casting magic one after another on the big sister’s friend and Sakura.
“Alright, here I go! Dragon Sanctuary!”
With a crackle, the rival cast the domain magic on the space just like the day before, creating a hole. The hole sparked as it barely opened, trying to close immediately.
“Here we go!”
“Piyo!”
In their chick forms, Sakura and the others followed behind the big sister’s friend, entering the hole one after another. The hole closed right after that.
Everyone, do your best!

About… 20 minutes passed? Just as Father and the others were starting to get worried because it was taking a while, the scenery changed with a crackling sound, like glass shattering, just like the day before.
“We did it!”
“Oh!”
Behind the big sister’s friend and Sakura and the others were several large stone eyeballs rolling around. They were about three times my size.
What on earth are these?
“This seems to be what was trying to close the hole Gaelion opened. It took a while to destroy them.”
“Calling them monsters… doesn’t quite fit.”
“Maybe golems? They seem to move according to set commands powered by magic.”
“Right. They seem to serve a magical function, but they’re probably a type of golem. Still, something feels off… maybe they’re closer to gargoyles?”
“They were pretty tough! Everyone, praise me!”
Sakura sheathed her sword and gave her thoughts.
“They were troublesome.”
“They were pretty fast too… but Kou was able to fight since he’s used to Rifana.”
“In front of Kuro, the Black Thunder, they were nothing.”
Yuki and the others also proudly responded. They performed wonderfully. The rival may have been a step ahead the day before, but this should make up for it.
“Can we go home now?”
“Hmm… judging by the looks of it, probably not.”
Father pointed at the red outline that was now closer than before.
“Is the sun going to rise again?”
“The night has only just begun. We might as well go as far as we can. Besides… going home looks difficult.”
“If there’s a device like this, maybe if we destroy whatever’s deeper in, we’ll be able to return.”
“Yeah. It’s like a fish trap… the way back might be intentionally designed to be difficult.”
“What should we do now?”
“We’re still moving forward. I’m not sure what lies ahead, but it doesn’t seem like it’s just getting more active. We have no choice but to keep going.”
At that moment, Father looked up. Ren and Itsuki also followed Father’s gaze and wore the same expression.
“What… what is it!? Spear Hero! Do you recognize that?”
“Unfortunately, I do.”
The rival and I were stunned in a different way when we saw it. As for what was flying…
“What is that!?”
Ren uttered the same words he did when he first saw it. Since Ren was pointing at the sky, I looked again. A sinister, devil-like creature was flying through the air.
Yes… it was the same type of demon that had flown over Melromarc when it was transformed into that wretched city last time.
“Father, I explained before that the Three Heroes Church summoned demons back in Melromarc.”
“Yeah. You said demons were flying back then.”
“For some reason, those demons are flying in the sky again.”
Could it be that the place that was destroyed overnight was due to the demon summoning?
“Does that mean this is the land that was destroyed overnight by the demon summoning and then sealed away?”
“I don’t know. On the other hand, it might be a stronghold for the demons now, set up to repel intruders.”
“According to the Dragon Emperor’s knowledge, demons were said to be created by a being once called the Demon King. But… since I haven’t seen it firsthand, I can’t be certain.”
“In any case, finding a cooler place before the sun comes up is the priority!”
You’re too sensitive to heat! Ren’s words made Itsuki nod, and Father gave a wry smile as he agreed.
“Demon-type monsters, huh? They don’t really communicate.”
“They’re more like magical constructs than monsters. And… the concentration of corrupted power is high. The corruption is severe, so the demons’ abilities are likely enhanced. Be very careful.”
“Yeah. For now, it looks like we have no choice but to keep moving forward.”

And so, although we came here for investigation, it seemed a battle with demons was about to begin. As we cut down countless demons along the way, the ruins with the red outline gradually came closer. Along the way, we encountered several barriers like the ones we had seen last night and tonight. Each time, the big sister or her friend noticed them and destroyed them. Some of the barriers had complicated destruction conditions. Even when they opened enough for someone to pass, there were traps that repelled the heroes. At those times, the big sister’s sister and the doctor played a crucial role in destroying the mechanisms. This time, the defense mechanism seemed to be monsters, and the doctor dismantled them brilliantly.
“This place… is seriously well-guarded. I can’t even imagine what they’re protecting.”
“I hate to say it, but… isn’t it probably the demons’ stronghold?”
“Is this the Demon Realm…? Well, it certainly gives off that vibe.”
With every barrier we broke, the color of the desert turned darker and more ominous. It truly felt like the heart of a demon’s domain.
“Still, it looks like we’ve managed to reach the capital of the fallen kingdom.”
Beyond the stone gate in the middle of the desert… we arrived at the ruins. It was quite a struggle, but they were no match for us.
